description: NASA's own 3D models of four Mars missions side by side: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, Mars Global Surveyor, the Opportunity rover and the Ingenuity helicopter, at the scale their files have or all the same size. Hover a spacecraft for what it did and its size in the file; beside them, every Mars model science.nasa.gov lists. Caveat: glTF's unit is the metre, but a model's makers don't always keep to it, so check a size against the mission's published one. Next: Perseverance: who built what, and NASA in 3D for the whole catalog.
name: Mars in 3D: the spacecraft
